title: See what is using disk space in macOS Storage settings
summary: System Settings has a Storage page that shows how much space each category uses, such as apps, documents and system data. Use it to find out what is filling your Mac's disk.

steps.explain: Open System Settings from the Apple menu in the top-left corner of the screen.
steps.gui: Click the Apple menu, then click System Settings.

alternatives.explain: Open the System Settings app from Terminal instead of the Apple menu.

steps.explain: In the sidebar, click General, then click Storage on the right.
Wait a few seconds while macOS works out the size of each category. The colored bar at the top and the list below show how much space apps, documents, system data and other items use.
